jobs_results.title: Software Developer Intern
jobs_results.description:
Wipro has an exciting Software Developer internship opening in Margao, Goa, ideal for freshers and final-year students eager to learn by doing. Over this internship you will focus on building, testing and shipping software features, collaborate with the team, and develop skills that employers actively look for.

About the Role
As a Software Developer at Wipro in Margao, Goa, you will focus on building, testing and shipping software features. You will have clear responsibilities, the tools and mentorship to succeed, and the chance to make a genuine impact while you learn.

Key Responsibilities
• Design, write and maintain clean, well-documented code
• Build and consume REST APIs and work with databases
• Debug, test and optimise application performance
• Participate in code reviews and Agile ceremonies
• Collaborate with product and QA to ship features
• Document your work clearly and act on feedback
• Coordinate with team members and maintain professional communication

Required Skills & Competencies
• Java
• Python
• JavaScript
• Data Structures & Algorithms
• OOP
• REST APIs
• SQL
• Git & GitHub
• Debugging
• Unit Testing

What You Will Learn
• Production software workflows and version control
• Writing maintainable, tested and reviewed code
• Working in an Agile engineering team

Who Can Apply
• Students in their final year and recent graduates interested in a Software Developer role
• Freshers looking to build a career in Software Development
• Candidates who know or are learning Java, Python, JavaScript, Data Structures & Algorithms
• Candidates based in or willing to work from Margao, Goa
• Career-switchers and self-taught learners who meet the requirements

Stipend & Internship Details
• Stipend: ₹12,000 – ₹30,000 per month
• Duration: 3–6 months
• Location: Margao, Goa (In-office)
• Joining: Immediate / Rolling

Benefits & Perks
• Internship Certificate on completion
• Letter of Recommendation for strong performers
• Hands-on mentorship from professionals
• Real, portfolio-worthy project experience
• Pre-Placement Offer (PPO) opportunity
• Flexible, learning-focused environment

Interview / Selection Process (4 rounds)
Round 1 — Application & Resume Screening: apply through the verified link on this page; profiles are shortlisted on fundamentals, skills and fit for the Software Developer role.
Round 2 — Aptitude / Skills Assessment: a short test or task covering software development fundamentals and basic Java.
Round 3 — Technical / Task Interview: hands-on discussion of the required skills (Java, Python, JavaScript) and a case or exercise.
Round 4 — HR / Mentor Round: your learning mindset, availability, stipend and start date.

Industry & Category
Industry: Information Technology & Software. Category: Software Development. This is a Information Technology & Software internship in Margao, Goa. Popular related searches: Software Developer internship in Goa, Software Developer internship in Margao, Information Technology & Software internships in Panaji Goa, Software Development careers in Goa.

Why Join Wipro
Wipro is a respected name in the IT Services sector with a strong presence connected to Goa. You will gain real exposure, work with industry-standard tools and grow alongside experienced professionals in one of India's most vibrant states.

How to Apply
Click "Apply Now" on this page. You will first be asked to log in or create a free candidate account, and you will then be securely redirected to Wipro's official careers/application page to complete your application. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, so early applicants have the best chance. Responsibilities: Design, write and maintain clean, well-documented code; Build and consume REST APIs and work with databases; Debug, test and optimise application performance; Participate in code reviews and Agile ceremonies; Collaborate with product and QA to ship features; Document work clearly and act on feedback. Requirements: Pursuing or recently completed a relevant degree/diploma; Working knowledge of Java, Python, JavaScript, Data Structures & Algorithms; Strong communication skills and a proactive attitude; Ability to work in a team and meet deadlines; Based in or open to working from Margao, Goa.

jobs_results.title: iOS Developer Intern at Wipro
jobs_results.description:
Wipro is hiring a iOS Developer Intern in Chennai for a 3-month, fully mentored internship. This is real, reviewed work on live projects — not a training sandbox or a certificate mill.

About the internship
You will join the iOS engineering team and work alongside people who do this professionally every day. From week one you own a scoped piece of work, take it through review, and see it ship.

Day-to-day responsibilities
• Build iOS screens with SwiftUI/UIKit.
• Integrate with backend APIs and local persistence.
• Fix crashes and layout issues across devices.
• Support TestFlight and App Store builds.
• Document your work clearly so the next person can pick it up.
• Take part in stand-ups, planning and review sessions with the team.

Tools and technologies you will use
iOS, Swift, Xcode, UIKit, SwiftUI, REST APIs, Git, Auto Layout, Debugging, App Lifecycle — plus the internal tooling Wipro uses day to day.

What you will learn
Native iOS development: Swift, layout systems, and Apple's review and release pipeline.

Team structure
You report to a senior team member who acts as your mentor, inside a pod of 6-10 people. Weekly 1:1s track progress and a mid-internship review tells you exactly where you stand.

What we expect from you
Curiosity, ownership and clear communication. You are not expected to know every tool listed — you are expected to have solid fundamentals, ask good questions, and document what you do.

Details: ₹15,000/month stipend · 3 months · Work From Home (Remote) · 1 opening · Chennai.

If you want to start a career in iOS development in Chennai, apply now. Responsibilities: Build iOS screens with SwiftUI/UIKit.; Integrate with backend APIs and local persistence.; Fix crashes and layout issues across devices.; Support TestFlight and App Store builds.; Document your work so the next person can pick it up. Requirements: Education: pursuing or completed B.E./B.Tech/BCA/MCA/B.Sc in CS, IT or a related discipline; Graduation year: 2025, 2026 or 2027 batch; Minimum 60% / 6.0 CGPA (relaxable for candidates with strong practical projects); Technical skills: working knowledge of iOS, Swift, Xcode, UIKit; Soft skills: clear written communication, ownership, willingness to document work; Experience: none required — freshers welcome; prior projects or certifications are a plus.

jobs_results.title: Cloud Computing Intern
jobs_results.description:
Join Wipro in Tiruchirappalli as a Cloud Computing Intern. This entry-level internship is designed for students and recent graduates who learn best by building, shipping and getting real feedback on cloud and DevOps work.

About the role
As a Cloud Computing Intern at Wipro, your core focus will be provisioning cloud infrastructure and automating deployments. You are attached to a named mentor, join the team's stand-ups and reviews, and are trusted with work that matters rather than filler tasks. Questions are encouraged, your output is reviewed properly, and you get the feedback you need to actually improve.

What you'll do day to day
• Work on provisioning cloud infrastructure and automating deployments alongside the core team
• Use AWS, Azure, Linux, Docker, Kubernetes on live, production-facing problems
• Turn your work into clear documentation, notes or decks for reviewers
• Take part in reviews and act on the feedback you receive
• Collaborate across functions — engineering, product, design or business as the work demands
• Follow the team's quality, testing and documentation standards
• Track and report your own progress against an agreed plan

Skills you'll build
You will build practical, demonstrable experience in AWS, Azure, Linux, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD, Bash Scripting, Monitoring & Logging, Cloud Security Basics — the exact toolkit that separates a hireable fresher from a CV full of coursework. No prior work experience is required. Curiosity, problem-solving ability and a willingness to learn matter far more here than a polished résumé, and every one of these skills is taught on the job.

Who should apply
Students in their final year or recent graduates from B.E./B.Tech/BCA/MCA based in or willing to work from Tiruchirappalli. You should be willing to learn AWS, Azure, Linux and able to communicate clearly in writing. Personal projects, coursework, certifications or open-source contributions strengthen your application, but none of them are mandatory.

Internship details
This is a 6-month internship in Tiruchirappalli, Tamil Nadu, with a stipend of ₹32,000 per month. You will be given a defined project so that you leave with infrastructure and a pipeline running in production. Working hours follow the team's normal business hours and the internship includes a certificate on successful completion.

By the end of the internship you will have hands-on command of the tools and workflows used in the field, plus the confidence that comes from solving genuine problems rather than textbook ones. Interns who excel are regularly offered a PPO and a path into a full-time position.

How to apply
Click Apply Now. If you are not logged in you will be asked to sign in and register first, after which you will be taken to Wipro's official careers page to complete your application. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis and seats are limited, so apply early. Responsibilities: Work on provisioning cloud infrastructure and automating deployments alongside the core team; Apply AWS, Azure, Linux, Docker to live, production-facing problems; Document your work clearly for reviewers and stakeholders; Participate in reviews and act on the feedback you receive; Collaborate across engineering, product, design or business as required; Follow the team's quality, testing and documentation standards. Requirements: Pursuing or recently completed B.E./B.Tech/BCA/MCA — 2026 freshers & final-year students welcome; Working knowledge of AWS, Azure, Linux (or a genuine willingness to learn them); Strong fundamentals in your discipline and clear problem-solving ability; Care with detail and the discipline to document your work; Clear written and verbal communication in English; Based in or willing to work from Tiruchirappalli, Tamil Nadu.

jobs_results.title: Platform Engineering Intern at Wipro
jobs_results.description:
Wipro is hiring a Platform Engineering Intern in Kochi for a 3-month, fully mentored DevOps and platform engineering internship. Wipro is a leading global information technology, consulting and cloud services company, and this internship puts you inside a team that runs real production workloads — not a training sandbox.

About the internship
You will join the DevOps / SRE team at Wipro Kochi and work on live infrastructure alongside engineers who build and operate it every day. From week one you own a scoped piece of work, ship it through review, and see it run.

Day-to-day responsibilities
• Build, configure and maintain CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation used by real product teams.
• Work hands-on with Kubernetes, Terraform, Docker, Linux on assigned modules.
• Write and improve automation scripts that remove manual, repeated effort.
• Help monitor system health, investigate alerts and document what you find.
• Participate in daily stand-ups, sprint planning and code/config reviews.
• Prepare runbooks and technical documentation for the work you deliver.
• Test changes in staging and support controlled rollouts to production.

Technologies and tools you will use
Kubernetes, Terraform, Docker, Linux, Golang, Internal Developer Platform, Helm, CI/CD, Cloud Computing, Automation — plus the internal tooling Wipro uses to run its platforms.

What you will learn
How code moves from a developer laptop to production safely and repeatably; how large engineering teams collaborate; and the engineering judgement that only comes from working on systems real customers depend on.

Team structure
You report to a senior engineer who acts as your mentor and sit within a pod of 6-10 engineers. Weekly 1:1s track your progress, and a mid-internship review tells you exactly where you stand.

What we expect from you
Curiosity, ownership and clear communication. You do not need to know everything on the tools list — you do need solid fundamentals in Linux and networking, and the discipline to document your work.

Details: ₹30,000/month stipend · 3 months · Hybrid · 3 openings · Kochi.

If you want to start a career in DevOps and platform engineering in Kochi, apply now through the official Wipro careers link on this page. Responsibilities: Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation for live product teams; Work hands-on with Kubernetes, Terraform, Docker, Linux; Automate repetitive operational tasks with scripts and infrastructure-as-code; Monitor system health, investigate alerts and document findings; Write runbooks and technical documentation; Participate in stand-ups, sprint planning and reviews. Requirements: Education: pursuing or completed B.E./B.Tech/BCA/MCA/B.Sc in CS, IT, Electronics or a related discipline; Graduation year: 2025, 2026 or 2027 batch; Minimum 60% / 6.0 CGPA (relaxable for candidates with strong practical projects); Technical skills: working knowledge of Kubernetes, Terraform, Docker, Linux; Soft skills: clear written communication, ownership, willingness to document work; Experience: none required — freshers welcome; prior projects or certifications are a plus.
